title: You can quote Scripture and still dodge surrender.
paragraphs: You can quote Scripture and still dodge surrender.
You can preach faith and still protect your pride.

Training modifies behavior.
Transformation dismantles self.

One builds religious confidence.
The other births holy dependence.

One makes you impressive in church.
The other makes you broken before God.
“Having a form of godliness but denying its power.” — 2 Timothy 3:5

God is not grading performance.
He’s searching for surrender.
Here’s the tension most won’t say out loud:
We don’t resist sin as much as we resist losing control.
And control feels safer than dependence.

Before you scroll, ask Him:
“Lord… am I trained — or truly transformed?”

Don’t answer quickly.
Let Him answer.
